column1: # The platform-neutral surface of KeySharp that the `ks` dialect carries.
# kind      command, function, variable, method or class
# class     the class a method belongs to, empty otherwise
# The names are the ones the audit of the KeySharp surface named, with the
# logic of the audit itself: the exports of the frozen files of
# `egm-review/keysharp-audit/surface/`, minus the ones that need Windows,
# or .NET, or a GUI, and minus the ones that are names of the v2 (those
# are parity, and the table of the v2 has them).
# The table is a contract like the other two: the parity test asks the
# tree about every name of it, and a name the tree stops carrying fails
# the build of a test and not a run of a script.
# The question is asked of the tree and not of one dialect: three of the
# names are names of the v1 (`A_Args`, `EnvUpdate` and `IsSet`), and the
# tree carries them in the v1, which is the dialect that has them. The
# rule is the one of the audit: a name is carried when the tree answers
